meta.prompt_source: 英语二 Part B 图表作文（用户提供题面：某高校学生每月参加志愿服务次数占比）

band.rationale: 对照第2节档位描述：该文'基本完成了试题规定的任务'，图表描述与评论两部分均有着落，'虽漏掉一些内容，但包含多数内容要点'（三类参与情况均提及）；'有一些语法结构或词汇方面的错误，但不影响理解'——错误虽几乎每句出现，但语义均可复原，未达到第二档'影响了对写作内容的理解'的程度；'采用简单的衔接手法，内容基本连贯，层次基本清晰'（三段式＋问答式衔接）。锚点核验：字数83词低于建议下限150词的2/3（100词），触发锚点3，任务完成维度减半且全文封顶第三档；语法错误几乎每段出现但未阻碍阅读，按锚点4取第三档低位，故总分定为区间下限7分。

dimensions.name: 切题与图表解读
dimensions.evidence: 35% students never join, most students only join one or two time.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 字数83词低于下限150词的2/3（100词），按锚点3本维度减半（上限2.5）且封顶第三档。图表三类情况均提及但仅引用35%一个数字，45%与20%未给出，全文未说明'每月'这一统计口径，且开头'very popular'与图表反映的低参与度相矛盾。

dimensions.name: 内容展开与评论
dimensions.evidence: I think one reason is students is busy with their homework, another reason is volunteer is boring.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 评论部分给了两方面原因、好处与建议，方向齐全，但每点仅一句且无任何展开（如'volunteer is boring'无解释、无例证），又受83词总量限制无法深入。

dimensions.name: 组织与段落逻辑
dimensions.evidence: Why this happen? I think one reason is students is busy with their homework, another reason is volunteer is boring.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三段式（描述—原因—结论）框架成立，但连接词误用（In conclude），段内衔接仅靠问答与并列，未使用图表作文常用的对比与数据衔接手段。

dimensions.name: 语法与句式控制
dimensions.evidence: In conclude, volunteer have many advantage.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 主谓一致（students is / volunteer have）、名词单复数（one or two time / many advantage）、动词句型（let students to do）等基础错误几乎每句出现；10个句子平均仅8.3词，全部为简单句，无从句等结构变化。

dimensions.name: 词汇与搭配
dimensions.evidence: It can make us happy and learn knowledge.
dimensions.deduction_reason: learn knowledge 为中式搭配错误；join 一词重复使用四次且多不带宾语（never join / join many times），全篇词汇量明显低于图表作文基本需求（如未出现 account for、percentage、participate 等）。

dimensions.name: 格式与卷面
dimensions.evidence: Nowadays, volunteer is very popular in university.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三段分段清晰（36/20/27词），预检无机械格式问题（mechanical_flags 为空），大作文无标题要求，格式无失分点。

consistency.adjustments: 初次试算：切题2.0＋内容1.0＋组织1.0＋语法0.5＋词汇0.5＋格式1.0＝6.0，落入第二档区间，与档位判断（错误密集但不阻碍理解、两项任务要求均有着落，应为第三档低位）矛盾。复核后确认：图表三类信息与题目要求的描述、评论两部分均有着落，评论含原因与建议两面，切题维度在字数锚点减半上限2.5之内上调至2.5，内容展开上调至1.5，总分7.0，恰落于第三档区间下限，校验通过。

sentence_edits.original: Nowadays, volunteer is very popular in university.
sentence_edits.issue: volunteer 是可数名词，单数裸用不合法，此处应指'志愿服务'这一活动概念，需用动名词 volunteering；in university 搭配也不自然。
sentence_edits.revised: Nowadays, volunteering is very popular among university students.

sentence_edits.original: From the chart, we can see some students do not like volunteer.
sentence_edits.issue: like 后不能直接跟裸单数名词 volunteer，应改为动名词；且图表呈现的是参与次数而非喜好，宜改述为参与频率低。
sentence_edits.revised: From the chart, we can see that some students rarely take part in volunteering.

sentence_edits.original: 35% students never join, most students only join one or two time.
sentence_edits.issue: 35% 后缺 of；两个独立分句用逗号连接（逗号粘连）；one or two time 中 time 需用复数 times；join 不带宾语搭配不完整。
sentence_edits.revised: 35% of the students never participate, and most participate only once or twice a month.

sentence_edits.issue: join many times 表达笼统别扭，且未给出'3次及以上占20%'这一关键数据。
sentence_edits.revised: Only 20% of the students take part three times or more.

sentence_edits.issue: 特殊疑问句缺助动词，且主谓不一致。

sentence_edits.original: I think one reason is students is busy with their homework, another reason is volunteer is boring.
sentence_edits.issue: students is 主谓一致错误，应为 are；两个独立分句构成逗号粘连；volunteer 指活动应用 volunteering。
sentence_edits.revised: I think one reason is that students are busy with their homework, and another is that some volunteer activities are not attractive.

sentence_edits.original: In conclude, volunteer have many advantage.
sentence_edits.issue: In conclude 词形错误，应为 In conclusion；volunteer have 主谓一致错误且应用动名词；many advantage 中 advantage 需复数。
sentence_edits.revised: In conclusion, volunteering has many advantages.

sentence_edits.original: It can make us happy and learn knowledge.
sentence_edits.issue: learn knowledge 为中式搭配（应为 gain knowledge）；并列结构不平行，learn 的逻辑主语混乱。
sentence_edits.revised: It can make us happy and help us gain knowledge.

sentence_edits.original: University should let students to do more volunteer.
sentence_edits.issue: 泛指高校应用复数 Universities；let sb do sth 不接 to do；do more volunteer 缺名词，应为 volunteer work。
sentence_edits.revised: Universities should let students do more volunteer work.

sentence_edits.issue: 泛指应用复数 Students；also 位置不当，宜放在 should 之后；do it 指代模糊。
sentence_edits.revised: Students should also take an active part in it.

improved_version:
As is clearly shown in the chart, student participation in volunteer work varies greatly: 35% of the students in this university never take part in volunteering, 45% do so only once or twice a month, and merely 20% participate three times or more. In other words, most students are only lightly involved in volunteer work.

Why is this the case? In my opinion, one reason is that students are busy with their coursework and can spare little time. Another reason is that some volunteer activities are not attractive enough.

In conclusion, volunteering has many advantages: it brings us a sense of fulfillment and helps us gain practical knowledge and social skills. Therefore, universities should organize more meaningful volunteer activities, and students should also take an active part in them.
top_problems: 字数严重不足：全文83词，仅为建议下限150词的55%（低于2/3阈值100词），触发锚点3，任务完成维度减半并封顶第三档，内容根本无法展开。
基础语法错误密度极高：主谓一致（students is / volunteer have）、名词单复数（one or two time / many advantage）、动词句型（let students to do）几乎每句出现，且10个句子平均仅8.3词、全为简单句。
图表信息覆盖不完整：仅引用35%一个数字，45%与20%未给出，全文未提'每月'统计口径，开头'very popular'还与图表反映的低参与度相矛盾。
practice_advice: 每天选一个统计图表，固定用三个句式写一段60词的描述（总体趋势句—最大占比句—对比句），每个数据都带上百分比数字，写完逐句核对主谓一致与名词复数；坚持两周可同时解决字数不足与语法错误密度两个问题。

patterns: As is clearly shown in the chart, ...
One reason is that ... ; another is that ...
